description: This source file contains implementation for the 'CosaReports' module, which provides backend APIs for report management within a broader COSA Data Model. It includes functions for creating, initializing, and removing report objects, as well as interfacing with network device status and traffic initialization functions.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CosaReportsCreate(VOID)
methods.description: Constructs and returns a new instance of the Reports object, allocating necessary memory.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaReportsInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the Reports object by calling network devices status and traffic initialization functions, and optionally device management initialization if enabled.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaReportsRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up and frees memory for the Reports object.
